1  The Police-Inspector of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused for the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec. 4 and 6 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Kushbu Kumar Jain.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 27-04-2014 at Palace ground, Bengaluru.
At the time of marriage, the accused demanded and received Rs. Three lakhs, 110 grams of gold jewels.
Thereafter, while CW-1 was residing along with accused at Chamarajpet, Bengaluru, the accused have tortured CW-1 mentally and physically and ousted her from the house.
Further the accused have received the dowry from CW-1 and also demanded additional dowry from CW-1 and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty in demand of more dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.22/2019 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Kempegowdanagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined 03 witnesses as PW-1 to PW-3 and got marked Ex.P.1 to P.3 documents.
As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined three witnesses as PW-1 to PW 3 and got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P3 documents.
Ex.P1 is the Spot panchanama.
Ex.P.2 is the Complaint and Ex.P.3 is the Statement of PW-3.

PW-1 Nanjundappa and PW-2 Vimal Gandhi have deposed in their examination in chief that they signed on Ex.P.1 as per Ex.P.1(a) and Ex.P.1(b) about 3 years back and they pleaded their ignorance about the contents in it.
These witnesses were treated hostile by the prosecution.
During the course of cross examination, they denied the suggestions made to them.
11. CW-1 was examined PW-3 Smt. Khusub Kumari Jain.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 27-04-2014 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty,
in demand of dowry and never abused and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-3 as hostile witness and cross examined her.

sentences.text:
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-3 being the informant, key and material witness,
PW-1 and 2 being mahazar witnesses have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witnesses have given go-bye to their own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witnesses, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
13. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under C.C.No.29105/2019 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. & Sec.4 and 6 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
